short: Behind on M06: the Conformer reads beam lines of one frame, missing the multi-frame context mappers have used since 2020, with no objective gain; a small naturalness gain, no intelligibility test.
position: The paper changes M06 (a Conformer, alone or with bi-LSTM, replacing a single-frame 2D-CNN) and is behind the field there: the Conformer is new to ultrasound-to-speech but both variants model beam lines within a frame rather than time, are compared only with the single-frame baseline, and do not improve MSE or MCD on the paper's own four speakers; as context only, a later re-implementation on one TaL1 speaker, a different setup, fails while multi-frame 3D-CNN and Transformer mappers lead. Evaluation (M12) is the usual MCD protocol, often paired with MUSHRA with a small naturalness gain for the bi-LSTM variant and no intelligibility measure; the abstract understates significant objective degradations, the parameter claim is wrong for the preferred model, and real-time potential is asserted without latency.
